Finding submitted.

**Result: TRANSITION — missing (fallback redline proposed)**

- **What I checked:** Article 12 in full (12.1–12.10, including the 12.6 termination-in-entirety mechanics, 12.7 reversion, 12.8 Terminated Territory, 12.10 survival and 12.10.2 sell-off), Section 9.7/9.8 return of Confidential Information, Section 12.5.2 (bankruptcy delivery of IP embodiments), and the during-term transfer provisions (3.8.5 regulatory/know-how transfer, 4.5.2–4.5.3 Manufacturing Technology Transfer).
- **Why it fails:** every post-termination mechanic runs toward Harpoon (we transfer or destroy data at Harpoon's election under 12.6.1(c) and carry the 12.7 reversion obligations). The only return mechanic that could help us, Section 9.7, is request-based, confined to Confidential Information, triggered only on termination (not expiry), and has no outer deadline ("as soon as reasonably practicable"). No transition-assistance period exists anywhere.
- **Cure:** a single inserted Section 12.11 at the fallback level — 90 days of transition assistance on expiry or termination and export of our data within 30 days. I deliberately did not add the preferred then-current-rates, machine-readable-format or certified-deletion elements, and left all existing reversion mechanics verbatim.
